value.rationale: A canonical smallest nontrivial symplectic sl2 toral extension has a known characteristic-zero rigidity theorem, so its complete bad-characteristic structure is a natural substantive gap. The integral cohomology determines the full prime-support and each degree, exposes nine char2 second-cohomology classes, and supplies an explicit nonisomorphic deformation. This is a structural modular boundary, not a routine substitution of an existing formula.
